answer: You can still sell us the car, but you'll pay the difference at the appointment after we compare our offer with your payoff letter, so bring that letter. Bring a cashier's check or a debit card for the difference, because we no longer accept personal checks and we don't accept credit cards. The help center doesn't cover anything specific to loans with Coastal Credit Union, or a full list of other documents to bring, so please contact a store about that. If you'd rather not pay the difference, you can keep the car, since an offer never obliges you to sell.
